card.name: Linking words after a doctor's title
card.fires_on: Small linking words or commas right after a named clinician's specialty or role, just before the hospital, clinic or position is named. Examples are 'at', 'as', 'to' and a comma.

modes.label: at/'s before institution
modes.description: The word 'at' or "'s" after a specialty or job title, leading into a hospital or clinic name.
modes.example: Dr. Denny Carter, an orthopedic surgeon<< at>> Southeast Georgia Health System in Brunswick, explains

modes.label: Comma after credentials
modes.description: A comma after a person's name and credentials, before their role or employer.
modes.example: Susan Lasker-Hertz, RN, MSN, CHPN<<,>> Director of Clinical Services, Denver Hospice

modes.label: as/the in role description
modes.description: Words like 'as' or 'the' introducing a clinician's position.
modes.example: serving<< as>> the Robinson Firm Chief.

card.writes: It lowers the odds of words like consultant and specialty, and slightly favors other workplace or chart-related words.
card.plain: It fires on the small word that links a doctor's name or title to the hospital or role that follows.
